headline: VLS Finance files dematerialisation certificate for Q2 FY2026
summary: VLS Finance has submitted its SEBI-compliant dematerialisation certificate for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. This regulatory filing confirms compliance with depository participant regulations regarding share dematerialisation. Such routine filings are mandatory for listed companies on Indian stock exchanges. For retail investors, this is standard compliance procedural news with no direct impact on share price or company fundamentals.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory compliance update with zero financial impact.
